## Personality

Jordan displays a tender and gentle disposition in his demeanor and work. He personally takes care of his tasks, demonstrating a level of care and softness that his mother compares to that of a woman.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

## History

Jordan went to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) during a particular winter for employment, where he fell in love with [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) Murray. After his father granted him a farm, Jordan brought [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and built a small dwelling where the couple resided for four years. During their time together, he crafted a garden for his wife that she passionately adored. Following Dinah's death, Jordan sold the farm and returned to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston), passing away around a decade later before his remains were returned to be interred beside her.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054)_
